archetype: Archetype 7 (Electric & Neon) blended with Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast)

typography.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter text-white
typography.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white

header.style: fixed w-full z-50 backdrop-blur-md bg-zinc-950/70 border-b border-white/10
header.interaction: Smooth sticky scroll. Links hover state: text-cyan-400

hero.layout: Flex column, centered text, massive gradient text, followed by absolute positioned 3D phone mockup

features_bento.style: Asymmetric bento grid. Uses glassmorphism cards. Some span 2 columns.
features_bento.icons: Lucide icons, size 24, with neon blue or purple glow

stats.style: Large fluid typography for numbers. Text clipped with primary gradient.

pricing.style: 2-column grid. Premium tier has 'Tracing Beam' glowing border effect using animated background.
pricing.cta: Primary button with neon glow for Premium, subtle outline for Free

admin_sidebar.style: w-64 fixed h-full border-r border-white/10 bg-zinc-950

admin_dashboard.style: Dense, technical grid (Control Room grid mode).
admin_dashboard.charts: Recharts with transparent backgrounds, cyan/purple line strokes, custom tailored tooltips matching dark theme

tables.style: Shadcn based table. border-b border-white/10, hover:bg-white/5

testing.requirements: ALL interactive elements MUST include data-testid. Format: data-testid='kebab-case-role-name'. Example: data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='admin-sidebar-users-link'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly use Javascript (.js) and JSX (.jsx) - NO Typescript.
Bilingual support is required. Implement a lightweight translation dictionary (PL/EN) or context provider to switch text globally.
Landing page should be visually stunning: Use framer-motion for scroll reveals and floating effects.
For the admin panel, use Recharts for all data visualization (Activity, Registrations). Ensure charts have responsive containers.
Apply 'Crystal Glass' rules from E1 persona to the header and dropdown menus.
Never use via.placeholder.com. Use the media URLs provided in this JSON.
Ensure the hero background image has a subtle overlay so text remains readable.
Use lucide-react for all standard icons.
Enforce Dark Mode permanently across the app as requested.
Build the UI prioritizing Shadcn UI components but strip Vercel-like styling to inject the neon/dark theme.
